# The lists live in .titanos/tasks, next to the calendars on the system
# data volume. When only they cannot be read, the home set is 503 (never
# a home without the lists: iOS would delete them), a calendar and its
# entries still answer, and an id that might be a list is 503, never 404.
@seed calendar privat 6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics dentist.ics
@seed tasks erinnerungen--titanos 4E2A9C11-7B3D-4F60-A1E2-3C4D5E6F7081.ics todo.ics
@tasks off

> PROPFIND /caldav/alex/calendars/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 1
< status 503
< header Retry-After 300

> GET /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics
> Auth: alex
< status 200
< body dentist.ics

> PROPFIND /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen--titanos/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 1
< status 503

> GET /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen--titanos/4E2A9C11-7B3D-4F60-A1E2-3C4D5E6F7081.ics
> Auth: alex
< status 503

> PROPFIND /caldav/alex/calendars/nothere/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 0
< status 503

@tasks on

> GET /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen--titanos/4E2A9C11-7B3D-4F60-A1E2-3C4D5E6F7081.ics
> Auth: alex
< status 200
< body todo.ics

> PROPFIND /caldav/alex/calendars/nothere/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 0
< status 404

# Without the volume both are 503, as before.
@volume off
> PROPFIND /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen--titanos/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 0
< status 503
